about_the_game:
Heart of Pacific is a visual novel for adults about three young women who arrive on an artificial tropical island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. The owner of the island is a famous inventor and billionaire, these days he will present the world with revolutionary technology in the field of artificial intelligence. What is passion? And what is evolution? Enter the world of futuristic philosophy in this upcoming romantic adventure.

CONTENT for the final game:

  • More than 1500 images in 4K resolution

  • 8 fully animated sex scenes in 4K resolution

  • 3 cinematic cutscenes

  • 6 female and 6 male characters for sex scenes

  • Original soundtracks and ambient music

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains romantic and public sex scenes
